texto: Distinguish the payment alternatives (**carta di credito** versus **bonifico bancario**) and the supporting documents that each modality requires.
Please note the time restrictions: **entro trenta giorni** (within 30 days) and the irrevocability of the application after its telematics.

bloques.titulo: Procedura per richiedere il rimborso online

frases.it: Per chiedere il rimborso di un corso, accedi all'area personale e seleziona «Le mie iscrizioni».
frases.es: Para pedir el reembolso de un curso, accede al área personal y selecciona «Mis inscripciones».
frases.en: To request reimbursement of a course, access the personal area and select «Mis inscripciones».

frases.it: Apri la scheda del corso interessato, poi scegli l'opzione «Richiedi rimborso».
frases.es: Abre la ficha del curso en cuestión, luego elige la opción «Solicitar reembolso».
frases.en: Open the course tab in question, then choose the «Request reimbursement» option.

frases.it: Il modulo online va compilato entro trenta giorni dall'acquisto.
frases.es: El formulario online debe cumplimentarse en el plazo de treinta días desde la compra.
frases.en: The online form must be completed within 30 days of purchase.

frases.it: Se hai pagato con carta di credito, allega la ricevuta digitale; se hai usato un bonifico bancario, indica la data e il codice dell'operazione.
frases.es: Si pagaste con tarjeta de crédito, adjunta el recibo digital; si usaste una transferencia bancaria, indica la fecha y el código de la operación.
frases.en: If you paid by credit card, attach the digital receipt; if you used a bank transfer, indicate the date and code of the operation.
analisis: se hai pagato con carta di credito
if you paid by credit card
se hai usato un bonifico bancario
if you used a bank transfer

frases.it: La richiesta non può essere modificata dopo l'invio, ma puoi contattare l'assistenza clienti per chiarimenti.
frases.es: La solicitud no se puede modificar después del envío, pero puedes contactar con atención al cliente para aclaraciones.
frases.en: The request cannot be changed after the shipment, but you can contact customer attention for clarification.
analisis: la richiesta non può essere modificata

frases.it: Le domande inviate dopo la scadenza del termine non vengono accettate dal sistema.
frases.es: Las solicitudes enviadas después del vencimiento del plazo no son aceptadas por el sistema.
frases.en: Applications sent after the expiry of the deadline are not accepted by the system.

bloques.pregunta: From which section of the web platform is the processing of the refund started?

opciones.texto: Desde el área personal del usuario, accediendo al apartado «Le mie iscrizioni».
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «accedi all'area personale e seleziona 'Le mie iscrizioni'».

opciones.texto: From a link received by text message on the mobile phone.
opciones.explicacion: The procedure is carried out directly on the student's personal web platform.

opciones.texto: From the public business promotion page of the entity.
opciones.explicacion: It requires authenticated user access to the personal account.

bloques.pregunta: What time limit is the student not able to complete the form?

opciones.texto: 30 days from the date of acquisition.
opciones.explicacion: The rule states: «il modulo online va compilato entro trenta giorni dall'acquisto».

opciones.texto: For a period of five working days before the beginning of the classes.
opciones.explicacion: It's 30 natural days since the course's purchase.

opciones.texto: For a full year provided you have not visualized the lessons.
opciones.explicacion: After 30 days, the right to proceedings expires.

bloques.pregunta: What justification should be attached if the payment was made by bank card?

opciones.texto: El recibo digital correspondiente a la transacción electrónica efectuada.
opciones.explicacion: Required: «se hai pagato con carta, allega la ricevuta».

opciones.texto: A picture of the back and back of the credit card.
opciones.explicacion: For security, photographs of bank cards are never requested.

opciones.texto: An income certificate signed by the issuing bank.
opciones.explicacion: The digital purchase voucher of the operation itself is enough.

bloques.pregunta: What specific data is required if the payment was formalized by transfer?

opciones.texto: The exact date of issue and the identification code of the transfer.
opciones.explicacion: It is indicated textually: «indica la data e il codice dell'operazione».

opciones.texto: The balance available in the applicant's current account.
opciones.explicacion: Private balance data are not required in the procedure.

opciones.texto: The name and last name of the director of the financial branch.
opciones.explicacion: Only the date and code of the bank operation are interested.

bloques.pregunta: What happens if a user needs to modify data after pressing the sending button?

opciones.texto: The telematics application is blocked, but can be accessed by the assistance service.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates: «non può essere modificata dopo l'invio, ma puoi contattare l'assistenza».

opciones.texto: The form is automatically deleted and must pay a penalty.
opciones.explicacion: There is no penalty, only the direct edition is blocked on the web.

opciones.texto: The system allows you to reedit the information as many times as you want.
opciones.explicacion: Once the file has been transmitted, it does not allow direct manual changes.

bloques.pregunta: What is the consequence of the short-term submission?
bloques.frase: Le domande inviate dopo la scadenza del termine non vengono accettate dal sistema informatico.

opciones.texto: The automatic and unappealable rejection of the request by the digital platform.
opciones.explicacion: «Non vengono accettate» means that they are excluded from processing.

opciones.texto: That the refund is paid with an administrative deduction of 50%.
opciones.explicacion: No extra-temporary reduction or procedure is allowed.

opciones.texto: That the application is transferred to the school year next year.
opciones.explicacion: The application is definitely due to expire on the deadline.

bloques.frase: Il modulo per la richiesta di rimborso va ___ entro trenta giorni dall'acquisto.

opciones.texto: compilato
opciones.explicacion: A particular meaning to fill in or complete an official form.

opciones.texto: compila
opciones.explicacion: It is present as an indication: «él cumplimenta».

opciones.texto: compilando
opciones.explicacion: It's the form of gerunde.

intro: Read this formal protocol of academic and administrative management. It pays attention to the time-frame, the required documents and the operational limitations of the system.
